findings.note: Barrett filed S.405, 'An Act mandating the posting of identification requirements at polling places'. Per the docket text, the state secretary must supply a notice for every polling place summarizing why a voter may be asked to show identification at check-in and the acceptable forms of ID under existing law (G.L. c.54 s.76B and 950 CMR 52 and 54). It also goes on the secretary's website, posted at least 8.5 x 11 inches. Referred to Election Laws; hearing held 2023-09-19; on 2024-02-15 it went with a study order (S2655).
subjects: voter ID at the polls
posting ID rules at polling places
election administration notice
